# Data
```{r}
standard_coverage <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_coverage.csv")
# standard_coverage_summary <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_coverage_summary.csv")
standard_wis <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_wis.csv")
```

# Subfigures
## Left
```{r}
standard_coverage <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_coverage.csv")
standard_coverage <- standard_coverage |> 
  select(location, target_end_date, horizon, reference_date, model_id, target, coverage_95, prediction_category) |>
  mutate(horizon = horizon + 1)

temp3a <- standard_wis %>% 
  left_join(standard_coverage, 
            by = join_by(location, target_end_date, horizon, reference_date, model_id, target))

table(is.na(temp3a$prediction_category))
```

```{r}
plot_df <- temp3a %>%
  group_by(model_id, prediction_category) %>%
  summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(model_id) %>%
  mutate(total_wis = sum(mean_wis)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(model_id = fct_reorder(model_id, total_wis))

plot_df$prediction_category <- factor(plot_df$prediction_category, levels = c("over", "on-target", "under"))
```

```{r, fig.height = 20, fig.width=10}
figure3a = ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = model_id, y = mean_wis, fill = prediction_category)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean WIS", fill = "Prediction Category") +
  theme_bw()
figure3a
```

## Top right
```{r}
temp3b = standard_coverage |> group_by(model_id, horizon) |> 
  summarise(mean_coverage = mean(coverage_95, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(model_id) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r, fig.height = 10, fig.width=10}
figure3b = ggplot(temp3b) + geom_tile(aes(y=model_id, x=horizon, fill = mean_coverage)) + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") + theme_bw() + labs(x="Horizon (1-4)", y = "Model", fill = "Mean Coverage (95%)")
figure3b
```


## Bottom right
```{r}
temp3c = rbind(
  standard_wis |>
    group_by(target_end_date, model_id) |>
    summarize(mean_wis = mean(wis, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
  standard_wis |>
    group_by(target_end_date) |>
    summarize(
      model_id = "AVERAGE",
      mean_wis = mean(wis, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
)

temp3c$target_end_date = as.Date(temp3c$target_end_date)
```

```{r, fig.height = 10, fig.width=10}
figure3c = ggplot(temp3c) + geom_line(aes(x=target_end_date, y=mean_wis, color = model_id)) + theme_bw()
figure3c
```

# Figure 3
```{r, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 20}
(figure3a + figure3b) / (figure3c)
```

## Save to file
```{r}
png("Figures/figure3.png", width = 1920, height = 1920)
(figure3a + figure3b) / (figure3c)
dev.off()
```
